tha-ap333:1.1: Ummāpupphiyavaggo tettiṃso. [331. Gandhathūpiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato gandhathūpam adās' ahaṃ / sumanehi paṭicchannaṃ Buddhānucchavikañ ca taṃ. // //
tha-ap333:2.1: Kañcanagghiyasaṅkāsaṃ sambuddhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / indīvaraṃ va jalitam ādittaṃ va hutāsanaṃ // //
tha-ap333:3.1: Vyagghusabhaṃ va pa*varam abhijātaṃ va* kesariṃ / nisinnaṃ samaṇānaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhataṃ // //
tha-ap333:4.1: Disvā cittaṃ pasādetvā paggahetvāna añjaliṃ / vanditvā satthuno pāde pakkāmiṃ uttarāmukho. // //
tha-ap333:5.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ gandham adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi *gandhapūjāy' idaṃ* phalaṃ.
